reads.text:
LATE METHODS — PRIMARY ORIGINAL CONTRIBUTION
We propose HELIOS-LATE, a hierarchical event-triggered graph scheduler. It combines uncertainty-gated queue partitioning with a rollback-safe temporal consistency rule. These two coupled mechanisms are the paper's independent technical contribution.
Experiments and limitations follow.
